findings.body_markdown: `json.dumps(payload)` (line 43) can differ from the transmitted body in key order, and receivers verifying the raw body reject it.

findings.title: deliver_webhook() retries a 410 Gone endpoint forever
findings.body_markdown: The retry loop only stops on 2xx (line 14); an endpoint that returns 410 is retried with backoff indefinitely and the queue for that tenant never drains.

severity.explanation: reachable from a public entrypoint × untested × proven × blast radius 0.40 × churn 0.30
